verdict.rationale: The probe shows a live ANEF digital-administration portal and notes that transactions sit behind its JavaScript application and an account, which suggests the core application process is online. However, no published page content could be read to confirm which transactions can be completed end-to-end online, and the parent ministry site blocked access. missing for 10: readable first-party pages stating the application/filing can be completed online, details of which procedures are covered, independent or hands-on corroboration.
